name: Stub
description: Ticket stubs with the perforation always in the same place, torn off along a straight line.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(7% 3% round 12%); clip-path: inset(7% 3% round 12%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 66%; top: 0; width: 6%; height: 100%; background: var(--color0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
